COMPLEX LITIGATION HEARING OF PETITION FOR COORDINATION HELD ON SEP-08-2010, IN DEPT. 304. THE COURT GRANTS THE PETITION FOR COORDINATION. THIS ACTION SHALL BE COORDINATED INTO THE REGLAN/METOCLOPRAMIDE CASES, JCCP 4631. THE COURT WILL PREPARE THE WRITTEN ORDER.
